title: Finale Mortar Rack — Bill of Materials
per_unit: One rack (5 rows × 5 tubes = 25 tubes). Build 2 identical racks for the full finale.
material: 5/8 in. wall boards + dowel rod (see cut list)

standard_stock.name: 2×4×8 ft
standard_stock.notes: Rip to 5/8 in. thick wall stock; yields all 24 boards for both racks (4 outside row + 12 column + 8 row dividers)

standard_stock.name: 2 in. dowel rod
standard_stock.notes: 18 in. × 4 cuts = 6 ft total (outer dowels, both racks)

standard_stock.name: 1-1/2 in. dowel rod
standard_stock.notes: 18 in. × 4 cuts = 6 ft total (inner dowels, both racks)

parts.name: Outside Row Board
parts.notes: row-board-bottom.scad — 24 in. centered on rack X; top-half lap at six column X.

parts.name: Column Divider
parts.notes: column-board-bottom.scad — bottom lap at brown; upper lap at blue mid rows.

parts.name: Row Divider
parts.notes: row-board-middle.scad — 24 in. centered on rack X; bottom edge z = 1-3/4 in.; bottom-half lap at columns.

parts.name: Mortar Tube
parts.notes: 2-3/8 in. OD × 12 in.; tilt per row angle when loaded.

building_two_racks.overview: Cut and notch all wall boards for both racks in one session, then assemble two identical frames. Load 25 tubes per rack on site.
steps: Print or open this BOM and preview rack.scad in OpenSCAD.
From three 2×4×8 ft studs (ripped to 5/8 in.), cut 4 outside row, 12 column, and 8 row divider blanks (sizes in parts table).
Notch all green columns, then brown ends, then blue mid rows (see README half-lap table).
Cut dowels: 4× 2 in. OD and 4× 1.5 in. OD, each 18 in. long.
Assemble rack A: columns → blue mid rows → brown ends → fasten → insert dowels → 25 tubes.
Repeat for rack B. Label A/B if fuse wiring differs.
Transport racks separately; place side by side on field; wire shells 47–96.

cut_layout.wall_stock: Three 2×4×8 ft — rip to 5/8 in.; all wall boards for 2 racks
cut_layout.dowel_stock: 2 in. rod: 18 in. × 4 = 6 ft · 1-1/2 in. rod: 18 in. × 4 = 6 ft (both racks)
tips: Each rack is 5×5 (25 tubes); build two racks for the 50-tube Commander finale.
Green boards are 18 in. long (depth); brown and blue span 24 in. (width), centered on rack.
Outer dowels (2 in.) at ±6 in. X; inner dowels (1.5 in.) at ±2 in. X.
Label racks A/B before loading tubes if shell-to-position mapping differs.
OpenSCAD models one rack; double every cut qty for two racks.
Print design/finale-mortar-rack/blueprint.svg for four-view plan, elevations, and assembly.
